description: Check an identifier's format and check digit: US ABA routing number, EIN, SSN (format rules only), ZIP; card numbers (Luhn) and IBAN; India GSTIN, PAN, IFSC, UPI ID, Aadhaar (Verhoeff) and PIN code. Proves a value is well formed, not that it's registered. Nothing is stored.
name: validate
title: Validate IDs: routing number, EIN, SSN, ZIP, card, IBAN, GSTIN, PAN, IFSC, UPI, Aadhaar, PIN
